videos.title: Why AI Agents Have Cursors
videos.description: AI agents don’t need cursors, but watching an onscreen cursor helps users understand and contextualize what they're doing. On AppStories, OpenAI's Andrew Ambrosino likens it to the AI era’s version of skeuomorphism; a visual cue to help users adjust to a new model of computing.
